apply_rules: Apply in the listed order on the RAW content (context=edit). Every "old" matches content.rendered exactly once at its turn (matches_in_live), except "replace_all" entries, which match exactly "expect_matches" times.

Edits with "spans_tags": true replace a whole <table> element: if "old" does not match the raw content exactly (raw line breaks between tags can differ), locate the single <table> element that contains "anchor" and replace that element with "new".

Every other old string sits inside one paragraph, list item or table cell and holds no HTML entity. The rendered content shows straight quotes (ש"ח, מ"ר) and no texturized characters, so raw and rendered text are expected to be identical inside a paragraph; re-check each old against the raw content right before applying.

tier 1 = sale-price alignment with the official list (conflicts, stale and unsourced sale figures); tier 2 = rent or other figures with no dated source. Applying tier 1 alone is valid (tier 2 olds do not overlap tier 1 results).
All or nothing per page: if any old does not match, write nothing. Re-fetch the page first; another session may have edited it. Data only: nothing here was applied.
notes: No conflicts on this page: the 3/4/5-room working ranges of the rooms table and of the FAQ all contain the official medians (1,936,700 / 2,392,600 / 3,631,900, 1-3.2026). They are kept word for word; the official median is added next to them (table column, FAQ first sentence). Not audited as claims (illustrations, not market statements): the 2,300,000 cost example (p@7295), the 2,700,000 budget example (p@9571), the buyer / seller / owner if-examples 2,420,000 / 2,550,000 / 2,400,000-2,480,000, 2,650,000 / 2,950,000, 150,000 / 180,000 (p@10058, p@10336, p@10594), the 8,000 / 4,500 rent example (p@17742), the six-step example table with its 'דוגמה מספרית' column (tr@26035..26925: 2,380,000-2,620,000 deals, 2,550,000-2,890,000 asking, 5,600-6,300 rent, 80,000 + 35,000 costs, 2,470,000 offer vs 2,650,000), the seller example 2,850,000 / 2,550,000-2,680,000 (p@27132), the 12% and 10% / 15% negotiation examples (p@27539, p@30137). Rent figures are kept: the page names samples ('לפי מדגם', 'בחלק מהמדגמים') and shows its check date 6.6.2026, but it never says the samples are listings; if a stricter reading is wanted, the rent table header 'שכירות חודשית לדוגמה' is the weakest point. Renovation-cost ranges (p@13670, tr@22065) are tier 2. Official quirks: Remez 5 rooms 4,153,600 is above the city 5-room median and Rambam 5 rooms is 2,497,900 (small samples). Qualitative text NOT edited but at odds with the official neighbourhood medians: the lead (p@4322) and the neighbourhood table (tr@11550..13426) present Ramat Eliyahu as 'נמוך עד בינוני' and Nahalat Yehuda among the older central areas, while the official 4-room medians are Ramat Eliyahu 2,295,000, Remez 2,140,200, Rambam 2,086,400, Abramovitz 1,941,000 and Nahalat Yehuda 3,460,700. The JSON-LD script and the closing disclaimer ('טווחי בדיקה') are outside the audit and unchanged. The official neighbourhood list in the city file holds exactly 8 names (it may be capped), so the text does not say that Neve Yam or Nobel have no published median; it says they are not in the table.
